p: When you create an account or book, we keep your name, phone number and email address, and the details of your bookings (what, when, where and the price).
If you sign in with Google or Facebook, we receive your name, email address and profile name from them. We never see your Google or Facebook password and we do not post anything on your behalf.
We use it only to run your bookings: to confirm or cancel them, to email you about them and to let the branch you booked with serve you.
We do not sell your data and we do not use it for advertising.
The managers and staff of the branch you book with, and the company owners and admins, can see your name, contact details and bookings.
We use an email service to send booking and password emails, and a storage service for uploaded pictures. They receive only what they need to do that.
We keep your account and bookings while your account is open. When you ask us to delete your data, we remove your personal details; see the data deletion page.
You can update your name and contact details in My account. You can ask for a copy of your data or for its deletion at any time by writing to {{email}}.

If you signed up with Facebook or Google, you can also remove this app from your Facebook or Google account settings; then write to us so we delete what we hold.
